label: r4c2
name: best + 2 PPO epochs
hypothesis: Same as r2c1, but ppo_epochs is 2. The budget gives about 1.86x more environment steps (about 243k, roughly 118 updates), with total gradient steps about the same as r2c1. Fresh, less reused data should cut overfitting to stale rollouts and expose the agent to more designs. Refuted if dev success is at or below 0.90, which would mean reusing each sample more is worth more than seeing more data.
